target_basis: Every overrun approved by the budget owner before month-end

measure: Paid before approval or never approved
target_basis: Payment run releases approved invoices only
Missing PO and Wrong cost centre cause 55% of rejections and can be caught at invoice entry; without them 7.1% of invoices would still be reworked, so the target leaves a margin

measure: Invoice spend with a purchase order
target_basis: No PO, no pay, with an exception list agreed with Procurement (defects counted per invoice)

measure: Discount invoices paid inside the discount window
target_basis: A 2/10 Net 30 discount earns 37.2% a year against an 8% cost of capital, so take every one; the gap allows for disputed invoices

measure: Paid on or before the due date
target_basis: Payment run selects by due date; the gap allows for invoices held back on purpose (disputes)

measure: Invoice to payment, weighted by amount
target_basis: Paying every invoice on its due date, or its discount date where a discount applies, gives 24.8 days (agreed terms: 29.9)
